details:
This update for hawk-apiserver, hawk2 fixes the following issues:

Changes in hawk-apiserver:

Version 0.2.4+git.1792406875.6ed758a:

  * Doc: update HA documentation URLs (bsc#1280368)
  * Dev: decouple Action and OpDefaults (code refactory)
  * enable custom user parameters (bsc#1274860)
  * cib/live/clones is handled in the hawk-apiserver instead of hawk
  * cib/live is handled in the hawk-apiserver instead of hawk
  * Add XInputsKvGroup (bsc#1267910)
  * Enable other Primitive-Operation attributes

Changes in hawk2:

Update to version 2.7.2+git.1789128469.a738abc1 (bsc#1267909):

  * Test: enable new attributes in test_check_cluster_configuration
  * Dev: update RSC_DEFAULTS and clone defaults
  * Test: give sle15 more time when choosing between sle15 and sle16
  * Dev: bump jQuery version to 4.0.0
  * Dev: bump jQuery version to 3.5.0
  * Dev: bump jQuery version to 2.2.4
  * Test: update the e2e test for the change allowing custom parameters
  * Dev: enable custom Parameters and Meta Attributes (bsc#1274860)
  * CI/CD: update hawk examiner entry point
  * Test: enable test_add_clone against hawk-apiserver verion 0.2.1
  * Test: fix SyntaxWarning: invalid escape sequence '\|'
  * Test: make the tests compatible against hawk-apiserver ver0.2.0

Bump rails stack v8.1.3.1, net-imap v0.6.6 and other gems to fix security issues:

 * CVE-2026-42246: net-imap: MITM attacker can cause Net::IMAP#starttls to return successfully, 
      without starting TLS (bsc#1268996)
 * CVE-2026-66066: unsafe image processing operations on untrusted
      uploads can allow arbitrary file reading and remote code execution (bsc#1273348)
 * CVE-2026-73490: loofah: improper handling of SVG
   attributes in the HTML5 sanitizer allows bypass of local-reference restrictions (bsc#1275179)
 * CVE-2026-73491: loofah: improper handling of javascript: URIs can lead to XSS (bsc#1275183)
 * CVE-2026-73492: loofah: improper handling of javascript: and vbscript: URIs can lead to XSS (bsc#1275188)
 * CVE-2026-73648: rails-html-sanitizer: cross-site scripting is possible when the sanitizer is configured
      to allow certain SVG reference elements (bsc#1275200)
 * CVE-2026-71847: json: heap use-after free in JSON::ResumableParser partial_value can 
      lead to crash on truncated duplicate-key streams) (bsc#1275213)
